entities.summary: Katarina Milovuk (1844–1913), was a Serbian educator and women's rights activist. She was the principal and director of the first institution of higher learning for women in Serbia, the Women's Grandes écoles in Belgrade, in 1863–1893, and founder of the first women's organization in Serbia, the Žensko društvo.
